method: Character accounting matches the renderer budget; UTF-8 bytes can differ and are not the budget.
Tag/attribute and all-text counts partition each XML part; quote/derived/source/field/item/execution counts are nested explanatory subsets, not additive.
Exact duplicate quote text requires same source ID/field/role/interval and identical decoded text.
Repeated attributes are only lexical sharing candidates: scope/role/uncertainty cannot be dropped without explicit inheritance/reference semantics.
Transport lower bounds for omitted originals exclude required record qualifiers; fitting a lower bound does not prove actual group fits.
No claim that all missing user sources are relevant or mandatory.
